title: Pure Shinobird
summary: Pure Shinobird Spirit and Ritual strategy centered around WIND Winged Beast spirits that return to the hand during the End Phase to trigger recursive search, disruption, and swarm effects. The deck leverages modern Stars Align support alongside generic Spirits and Link staples to bypass traditional Spirit summoning limits.

summary.title: Starters
points: Shinobaron Shade Peacock counts as Shinobaron Peacock and tributes itself from hand or field to add a Spirit monster and a Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.
Shinobaroness Shade Peacock counts as Shinobaroness Peacock and can be tributed to add a Spell or Trap that mentions Spirit monsters from your Deck to your hand.

Stars Align Above the Shrine is a Field Spell that can Ritual Summon a WIND Ritual Monster directly from your Deck by tributing Spirit monsters whose Levels equal or exceed the Ritual Monster's Level.
Sakitama reveals itself in hand to perform an extra Normal Summon of a Spirit monster, and adds a Spirit monster from your GY to your hand when tributed.

summary.title: Opening: Stars Align Above the Shrine + Sakitama
steps: Activate Stars Align Above the Shrine to access your Deck-tributing Ritual engine.
Reveal Sakitama in hand to Normal Summon Shinobird Crane from your hand without using your standard Normal Summon.
Activate Stars Align Above the Shrine to Ritual Summon Shinobaroness Shade Peacock or Shinobaron Peacock directly from your Deck by tributing Spirits on field or in hand.
Trigger Shinobird Crane to draw a card, and trigger Shinobaron Shade Peacock to search another Spirit monster and Shinobird's Calling.
During the End Phase, when your Spirit monsters return to the hand, trigger Stars Align Above the Shrine and Shinobird Power Spot to recover fallen Spirits and search follow-up pieces.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Shinobaron Peacock returns up to 3 monsters your opponent controls to the hand on Ritual Summon, then Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Spirit monster from your hand ignoring its summoning conditions.

Shinobaroness Peacock shuffles up to 3 Spells and Traps your opponent controls into the Deck on Ritual Summon, then Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Spirit monster from your Deck ignoring its summoning conditions.
Shinobird Salvation destroys 1 card your opponent controls whenever a face-up WIND monster returns to your hand, and banishes itself from the GY to end the opponent's Battle Phase.
I:P Masquerena uses small Spirits before they bounce in the End Phase to Link Summon disruptive Link Monsters on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Shinobird's Calling Ritual Summons Shinobaron Peacock or Shinobaroness Peacock by tributing monsters from your hand or field, or by banishing Spirit monsters from your GY.
Shinobird Power Spot adds a Spirit monster or Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand whenever a face-up WIND monster returns to your hand.
Stars Align across the Milky Way reveals a Ritual Monster in hand to add a Ritual Monster with the same Level but different name from your Deck, and recycles itself from the GY.

Shinobaron Peacock
Level 8 Ritual: bounces three monsters; summons a small Spirit.
Shinobaroness Peacock
Level 8 Ritual: spins three Spells/Traps; summons a Spirit from the Deck.

Spirit: draws when another Spirit is summoned.

Spirit: returns another Spirit to the hand to reuse it.
Shinobird Crow
Spirit: discards a Spirit for ATK in battle.
Sakitama

Stars Align Above the Shrine
Newest Field Spell: Ritual Summons a WIND Ritual from the Deck; recovers on returns.
